data.one_liner: A set of recommended lints for Flutter projects to enforce coding standards.
data.what_it_does: Provides a curated list of analysis lints that help catch common mistakes and enforce best practices. It is included via an analysis_options.yaml file and runs at compile time.
use_when: Enforce consistent code style across a team
Catch potential bugs early in development
Maintain a clean codebase for long‑term projects
avoid_when: Using in production code where lints are not evaluated
Relying on lints to replace runtime validation
strengths: Comprehensive and up‑to‑date with Dart SDK changes
Easy to add as a dev dependency
weaknesses: Only affects analysis, not runtime behavior
May conflict with other custom lint sets

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter lint set with similar goals and broader community support

data.minimal_example:
```yaml
# pubspec.yaml
dev_dependencies:
  carapacik_lints: ^3.13.1

# analysis_options.yaml
include: package:carapacik_lints/core.yaml
```
